complete_examples.text: In the coupled rail–slab–CSL-subgrade element, the slabs are no longer continuously supported by the cement– asphalt (CA) mortar, the rail pads are modeled as discrete massless springs with stiffness krs and dampers with damping coefficient crs connecting rail and slabs, CA mortar is modeled as continuous massless springs with stiffness ksc and dampers with coefficient csc connecting slabs and CSL, and the subgrade bearing layer is modeled as continuous massless springs with stiffness kcs and dampers with coefficient ccs connecting CSL and subgrade.
